title: Agentic RAG Assistant for Live GitHub Repositories
description: Agentic RAG assistant that answers multi-hop questions about live GitHub repositories with cited answers, cross-session memory, and full execution tracing.
highlights: Built and deployed an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system in Python and FastAPI that answers multi-hop questions over live GitHub data (issues, pull requests, commits) by breaking each question into 2–5 sub-questions and orchestrating LLM tool calls.

Designed a selective long-term memory layer in SQLite that stores only 0–3 durable facts per run, with Jaccard-similarity deduplication and keyword/tag retrieval, so facts recalled across sessions are cited in later answers.

Implemented end-to-end observability: every run produces a structured Pydantic trace (plan, tool calls, evidence, memory, citations, latency) that is saved as JSON, served through REST endpoints, and optionally sent to Langfuse.

Built a provider-agnostic LLM layer (OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI Grok) with bounded timeouts and retries plus a deterministic offline fallback at every LLM call site, so the system keeps working through provider failures and with no API key.

Containerized the app with a multi-stage, non-root Docker image, deployed it to Render, and covered it with 86 pytest tests, including resilience tests and security tests that keep user-supplied GitHub tokens out of logs and stored traces.

title: InSyfy — Autonomous Research Agent
summary: A research agent that plans, searches, and synthesizes—with persistent memory and citations that keep every claim grounded.
description: Designed and built a multi-agent research system on LangGraph: a planner fans out parallel web search, hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword + cross-encoder reranking) pulls from a persistent Qdrant memory, and synthesis is gated by a citation-enforcement layer that declines claims lacking sufficient evidence rather than hallucinating. Added a self-critique retry loop, real-time SSE progress streaming, and independently diagnosed and fixed concurrency and data-integrity bugs (a blocking event loop, broken event-log pagination, invalid vector-DB IDs) that don't surface in a casual demo.

title: Multimodal Sentiment Chatbot
summary: Voice-enabled conversations with a multi-model router, fine-tuned sentiment detection, and cloud or local inference.
description: Built a multi-model inference router combining cloud (SageMaker) and local (Phi-2) backends, with dynamic routing based on query complexity. Fine-tuned BERT for sequence classification on 160K labelled tweets; achieved 93% F1-score with voice input/output via STT/TTS.

title: Crop Disease Detection System
summary: A vision pipeline that identifies grape leaf disease and delivers real-time predictions through an API and dashboard.
description: Achieved 93% test accuracy on a Grape Leaf Disease 4 Class using transfer learning (CNN backbone) with augmentation and fine-tuning of classification head. Deployed model behind a REST API (FastAPI) with a Streamlit dashboard for real-time image upload and inference.
